title: ali aa rahe hai ali aa rahe hai
body:
do aalam hai farhaa'n payambar hai shaadaa'n ali aa rahe hai
nikal jaayenge aaj kaabe ke armaa'n ali aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi apne bhai ko hathou pe lenge, ali dekh mustafa ko hasenge
hai deeware kaaba masarrat se qandaa'n ali aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zulme baatil na kaaba sahega, quda ke makaa'n pe na qabza rahega
buto taqliye ka karo tum bhi samaa'n ali aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jalalat ke tewar se marhab hai shashdar, wo haibat ka aalam ke hairaa'n hai antar
ajab roub hai baabe qaibar hai larzaa'n ali aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
wo hai noore afsha'n gore risalat, masarrat se ubhri hai mohre nabuwat
hai kaaba bhi apne muqaddar pe naaza'n ali aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke liye qud payambar badhenge, nabi nafs ko apne ab dekhlenge
mujassam hue hai mohammad ke armaa'n ali aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
badhi peshwaayi ko qud kamyaabi zamee'n par qadam rakhti hai buturabi
na kyu qaake makka ho qismat pe naaza'n ali aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mohibbo ki mehfil badhi pur ziya hai, ali ke taswwur ka jalwa hua hai
dilou me masarrat se ab hai charaghaa'n ali aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
malaik me ek shor salle alaa hai, yahi to haqeeqat me waqte dua hai
quda ki hai rehmat ke darya me toofa'n ali aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ali me hai *baqar*jalaale qudai, kalaai me hai zore qaibar kushai
hui mushkile sab payambar ki aasaa'n ali aa rahe hai
